[[Emeju's Longbow]] is a [[unique item]] dropped by [[Emeju Longlegs]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Lahtenda Bog]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 12-21 (Requires 6 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +10% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +20

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Aureate Longbow]].
